BONUS
4) BIOLOGY – Multiple Choice Which of the following enzymes catalyzes the
committed step of glycolysis, the conversion of fructose-6-phosphate to
fructose-1,6-bisphosphate?
W) Hexokinase [hek-soh-KY-nays]
X) Phosphofructokinase [fos-foh-fruk-toh-KY-nays]
Y) Pyruvate kinase [py-ROO-vayt KY-nays]
Z) Aldolase [AL-duh-lays]
ANSWER: X) PHOSPHOFRUCTOKINASE
